_readme: TIER 2 - mildly sensitive. Kept OUT of profile.json on purpose.
Rule: this file is opened only when a specific application form actually asks
for one of these fields. It is not read on routine runs. The reason for the
split is that name + DOB + permanent address together are the combination that
becomes useful for identity theft; none of them are needed to fill a typical
NEVER STORE HERE: SSN, driver's license number, bank details.
Type those yourself on the review screen if a legitimate form ever asks.
_accounts_note: Portal sign-in credentials, keyed by ATS name (e.g. successfactors, workday, paylocity). Read ONLY by the engine's signIn helpers (apply_core.loadAccount), never typed into an application field. setup.mjs fills this section for you.
